item.title: Competing for Supplier Resources: Reverse marketing, customer attractiveness, supplier satisfaction and preferred customer treatment
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how organizations compete for valuable supplier resources and the mechanisms through which they establish themselves as preferred customers. It explores the strategic and relational dynamics that influence supplier decisions about resource allocation and customer prioritization.

Appel publié par Journal of Purchasing and Supply Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Reverse marketing
  • Customer attractiveness
  • Supplier satisfaction
  • Preferred customer treatment
  • Buyer-supplier relationships
  • Resource allocation in supply chains
